description: Baseline: monochrome code editor with gutter, text area, minimal status bar. No syntax highlighting, no current-line highlight, no header bar. Looks like nano.
ANSI syntax highlighting (TS/JS/Python/Bash via syntax-highlight.ts), header breadcrumb bar, active gutter line, rich status bar (language, encoding, indent, lines, scroll%). 4.4 to 8.0 in one shot.
Toolbar buttons (Save/Find/Goto) with accent colour and hover effects, current-line background highlight on gutter and text. Layout at 9, coherence at 9.
